papers.title: Conch fest flyer
lines: Conch salad, conch fritters, conch chowder. The conch themselves are not on the guest list.
Music from 4pm. Dancing from 5pm. Regrets from Monday.

papers.title: Ripsaw band card
lines: Ripsaw is played on a carpenter's saw with a screwdriver, with a drum and an accordion.
Do not try this at home. Do try it on the beach, at a safe distance from the crowd.

trail.clue: A band left its takings in a conch shell near the windpump. 'Find the shell, find the money.'

papers.title: Salt-raker's note
lines: Salt was the island's treasure. Raked in the pans, dried in the sun, shipped to the world.
The pans are quiet now, and the flamingos have taken over.

papers.title: Letter from a cousin
lines: Dear Pat, I am writing from a beach so white that I need two sets of sunglasses.
The work is hard, the sun is hot and the people are kind. I may stay. Tell Mam I have a hat.
